assessment_type: AI-authored post-hoc qualitative review; unreviewed by humans
assessor: Codex assistant; not independent of implementation
method: Read raw answers and admitted contexts, then assess each existing rubric item with exact excerpts. No keyword score or automatic accuracy metric.
limits: Seven authored questions from one pack; judgment labels are fallible; passing a rubric does not remove collateral answer errors or output truncation.
